notes: Right half of 1922 vol 1 plate 3; the gutter is at about x 1045 and everything west of it is the left page seen across the fold (L x ~ R x + 4627), strongly distorted: there West 8th sits near y 400 instead of ~450. Gutter-overlap intersections picked on both halves: McLean Avenue / West 8th Street and McLean Avenue / West 7th Street (McLean ends at 7th). No other intersections fall in the overlap strip (R x 0-2200: only E-W streets and the Deming Alley dead end). Names as printed: VANHORNE (the 20 ft street from Laurel Alley, west of Freeman) and VANHORN ST. (east of Freeman) are spelled differently on this plate and recorded as printed. LAUREL ... ALLEY, DEMING ... ALLEY, SIBLEY ... ALLEY (no '(SLOO)' bracket in 1922), HORN ... ALLEY (letters printed either side of Harriet), ZACHARY ... ST. (no '(TAYLOR)' bracket), MELVIN printed bare; the letters DONNERSBERGER'S spread over the blocks either side of Melvin are an owner label, not a bracketed street name. No bracketed old names seen on this half. Harriet: 50 ft north of Budd (centre x~3287), 30 ft from Budd to the yard (centre x~3258, shares the west face), and a separate 40 ft southern section (centre x~2993-2997) from the yard edge across Horn Alley, West 6th, Sloo and W. Front to the river. Harriet/Budd is an offset crossing (Budd centre y~1845 west, ~1868 east; Harriet 3287 north, 3258 south); point = middle of the four block corners. Harriet/Sloo likewise: Sloo is 18 ft west of Harriet (centre y~4937) and 40 ft east of it (centre y~4963), one label 'SLOO ... ST.' spans both; point = middle of the corners. Harriet/Horn Alley: alley centre ~3790 west, ~3780 east. West 7th exists west of Harriet (T from the west) and east of Carr (T at Carr, crosses Freeman); West 8th is ~60 ft east of McLean. Carr is continuous from 8th through the yard (tracks cross at grade) to W. Front, where it ends (T). Freeman crosses the yard on a bridge (no intersections between Kenyon and Zachary); Vanhorn, Barr and Kenyon start at Freeman (T from the east); Zachary, Sloo, Sibley Alley and Sargent run Carr to Freeman (T at both); West 6th crosses Carr and Freeman. W. Front: no width label seen on this half other than '60' at Carr; centre taken mid-way between the north block line and the south property line (~60-66 ft, tracks in the street). Freeman/W. Front is the least certain point (about 20 px): Front bends from ESE to ENE at Freeman and the junction is drawn with curves, so the point is Freeman's centreline (faces 6256/6442) on the centreline of Front east of Freeman. Unnamed 8 ft alley (dashed sewer in it) from Carr to the west end of Vanhorne recorded under alleys, not as an intersection.
